sql1:
WITH
latest_bldg AS (
  SELECT h.*
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h
  JOIN (
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_fiscal_period
    FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) m
    ON m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND m.max_fiscal_period = h.FISCAL_PERIOD
),
bldg_parent AS (
  SELECT
    lb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(lb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), lb.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS parent_building_number,
    CASE
      WHEN lb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      ELSE lb.BUILDING_TYPE
    END AS building_type,
    lb.EXT_GROSS_AREA
  FROM latest_bldg lb
),
street_addr AS (
  SELECT
    fba.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      NULLIF(TRIM(fba.STREET_NUMBER), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(fba.STREET_NAME), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(fba.STREET_SUFFIX), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL), '')
    ) AS street_address,
    fba.CITY,
    fba.STATE,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
emp_in_bldg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    ed.MIT_ID AS mit_id
  FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
    ON fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION
),
eligible_buildings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    bp.parent_building_number,
    bp.building_type,
    bp.building_key,
    bp.EXT_GROSS_AREA
  FROM bldg_parent bp
  JOIN street_addr sa
    ON sa.building_key = bp.building_key
  JOIN emp_in_bldg eib
    ON eib.building_key = bp.building_key
),
parent_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    eb.building_type,
    eb.parent_building_number,
    SUM(eb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS parent_gross_area
  FROM eligible_buildings eb
  GROUP BY eb.building_type, eb.parent_building_number
),
type_building_counts AS (
  SELECT
    building_type,
    COUNT(*) AS num_buildings
  FROM parent_rollup
  GROUP BY building_type
),
type_employee_counts AS (
  SELECT
    eb.building_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT eib.mit_id) AS num_employees
  FROM eligible_buildings eb
  JOIN emp_in_bldg eib
    ON eib.building_key = eb.building_key
  GROUP BY eb.building_type
),
type_address_counts AS (
  SELECT
    eb.building_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.street_address) AS distinct_street_addresses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.city) AS distinct_cities,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.state) AS distinct_states,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.postal_code) AS distinct_postal_codes
  FROM eligible_buildings eb
  JOIN street_addr sa
    ON sa.building_key = eb.building_key
  GROUP BY eb.building_type
),
type_gross_area AS (
  SELECT
    building_type,
    SUM(parent_gross_area) AS total_gross_area
  FROM parent_rollup
  GROUP BY building_type
),
by_type AS (
  SELECT
    tbc.building_type,
    tbc.num_buildings,
    tec.num_employees,
    tac.distinct_street_addresses,
    tac.distinct_cities,
    tac.distinct_states,
    tac.distinct_postal_codes,
    (tga.total_gross_area / NULLIF(tec.num_employees, 0)) AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
  FROM type_building_counts tbc
  JOIN type_employee_counts tec
    ON tec.building_type = tbc.building_type
  JOIN type_address_counts tac
    ON tac.building_type = tbc.building_type
  JOIN type_gross_area tga
    ON tga.building_type = tbc.building_type
)
SELECT
  building_type,
  num_buildings,
  num_employees,
  distinct_street_addresses,
  distinct_cities,
  distinct_states,
  distinct_postal_codes,
  avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM by_type
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS building_type,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT parent_building_number FROM parent_rollup) x) AS num_buildings,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) FROM emp_in_bldg eib JOIN eligible_buildings eb ON eb.building_key = eib.building_key) AS num_employees,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT street_address) FROM street_addr sa JOIN eligible_buildings eb ON eb.building_key = sa.building_key) AS distinct_street_addresses,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM street_addr sa JOIN eligible_buildings eb ON eb.building_key = sa.building_key) AS distinct_cities,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT state) FROM street_addr sa JOIN eligible_buildings eb ON eb.building_key = sa.building_key) AS distinct_states,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT postal_code) FROM street_addr sa JOIN eligible_buildings eb ON eb.building_key = sa.building_key) AS distinct_postal_codes,
  (
    (SELECT SUM(parent_gross_area) FROM parent_rollup) /
    NULLIF(
      (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) FROM emp_in_bldg eib JOIN eligible_buildings eb ON eb.building_key = eib.building_key),
      0
    )
  ) AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN building_type = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  building_type;

    AND su2.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'

detail AS (

    AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft,
    0 AS sort_key

),

    space_name,

Use a single **ROLLUP** to include subtotals and the grand total, with these rollup labels: show **“SUBTOTAL”** for a missing **usage type** only when an access level exists; show **“SUBTOTAL”** for a missing **space name** only when a usage type exists (otherwise leave it blank). Order by access level, then usage type, then space name (alphabetical), with rollup rows sorting last within each group (e.g., using a `'zzz'` sort key for rollup rows). Finally, **display access level and usage type only when they change from the previous row** (LAG-style), and format count/total/average as whole numbers with comma separators.

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(z.ACCESS_LEVEL, 'TOTAL') AS access_level,
    su_usage.SPACE_USAGE AS usage_type,
    fo.DLC_NAME AS space_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT) AS distinct_spaces,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_area,
    AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_area
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
  JOIN SPACE_USAGE su_usage
    ON su_usage.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z
    ON z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
  WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
    AND z.BUILDING_COMPONENT = '32'
    AND su_usage.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(z.ACCESS_LEVEL, 'TOTAL'),
    su_usage.SPACE_USAGE,
    fo.DLC_NAME WITH ROLLUP
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    CASE
      WHEN usage_type IS NULL AND access_level IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE usage_type
    END AS usage_type_lbl,
    CASE
      WHEN space_name IS NULL AND usage_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE COALESCE(space_name, '')
    END AS space_name_lbl,
    distinct_spaces,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    CASE WHEN access_level IS NULL THEN 'zzz' ELSE access_level END AS s_access,
    CASE WHEN usage_type IS NULL THEN 'zzz' ELSE usage_type END AS s_usage,
    CASE WHEN space_name IS NULL THEN 'zzz' ELSE space_name END AS s_space
  FROM agg
),
shown AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN access_level = LAG(access_level) OVER (ORDER BY s_access, s_usage, s_space) THEN ''
      ELSE access_level
    END AS access_level_display,
    CASE
      WHEN usage_type_lbl = LAG(usage_type_lbl) OVER (ORDER BY s_access, s_usage, s_space)
           AND access_level = LAG(access_level) OVER (ORDER BY s_access, s_usage, s_space) THEN ''
      ELSE usage_type_lbl
    END AS usage_type_display,
    space_name_lbl AS space_name,
    distinct_spaces,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    s_access, s_usage, s_space
  FROM labeled
)
SELECT
  access_level_display AS access_level,
  usage_type_display AS usage_type,
  space_name,
  FORMAT(distinct_spaces, 0) AS distinct_space_count,
  FORMAT(total_area, 0) AS total_area_sqft,
  FORMAT(avg_area, 0) AS avg_area_sqft
FROM shown
ORDER BY s_access, s_usage, s_space;

WITH base AS (

    ss.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    DATEDIFF(

    ) AS term_duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
    ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
    AND ss.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    GROUPING(IS_CURRENT_TERM) AS g_is_current_term,
    GROUPING(CLUSTER_TYPE) AS g_cluster_type,
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(CLUSTER_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      WHEN GROUPING(CLUSTER_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT'
      ELSE 'NON-CURRENT'
    END AS assign_label,
    MAX(term_duration_days) AS max_term_duration_days,
    AVG(term_duration_days) AS avg_term_duration_days,
    MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY IS_CURRENT_TERM, CLUSTER_TYPE WITH ROLLUP
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    CASE
      WHEN assign_label = LAG(assign_label) OVER (ORDER BY IS_CURRENT_TERM DESC, assign_label, CLUSTER_TYPE ASC)

      ELSE assign_label
    END AS assign_status_label,
    max_term_duration_days,
    avg_term_duration_days,
    max_total_units,
    avg_total_units
  FROM agg
)
SELECT

  CLUSTER_TYPE,
  assign_status_label,
  max_term_duration_days,
  avg_term_duration_days,
  max_total_units,
  avg_total_units
FROM final
ORDER BY
  IS_CURRENT_TERM DESC,
  assign_status_label,
  CLUSTER_TYPE ASC;

- if **GROUPING(CLUSTER_TYPE)=1 and GROUPING(IS_CURRENT_TERM)=1** → **'TOTAL'**

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    ss.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(ss.CLUSTER_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(at.IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      WHEN GROUPING(ss.CLUSTER_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(at.IS_CURRENT_TERM) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT'
      ELSE 'NON-CURRENT'
    END AS assign,
    MAX(DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(at.TERM_END_DATE,'%d-%b-%y'), STR_TO_DATE(at.TERM_START_DATE,'%d-%b-%y'))) AS max_duration,
    MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(at.TERM_END_DATE,'%d-%b-%y'), STR_TO_DATE(at.TERM_START_DATE,'%d-%b-%y'))) AS avg_dur,
    AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_unit
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
    AND ss.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY at.IS_CURRENT_TERM, ss.CLUSTER_TYPE WITH ROLLUP
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    assign,
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    max_duration,
    max_units,
    avg_dur,
    avg_unit,
    IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    LAG(assign) OVER (
      ORDER BY IS_CURRENT_TERM DESC, assign, CLUSTER_TYPE ASC
    ) AS prev_assign
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN assign = prev_assign THEN NULL ELSE assign END AS assign,
  CLUSTER_TYPE,
  max_duration,
  max_units,
  avg_dur,
  avg_unit
FROM ordered
ORDER BY IS_CURRENT_TERM DESC, assign, CLUSTER_TYPE ASC;

For courses offered by the **Biology** and **Chemistry** departments, summarize term duration and units grouped first by whether the term is current and then by department.

Compute **term duration (days)** as `DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(term_end_date,'%d-%b-%y'), STR_TO_DATE(term_start_date,'%d-%b-%y'))` (the dates are stored as `DD-Mon-YY` text).

For each group, return:
- a status label that is exactly **“CURRENT”** when `IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'` and **“NON-CURRENT”** otherwise,
- `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
- **max** term duration, **max** units,
- **avg** term duration, **avg** units.

Include rollup rows from this same two-level grouping:
- when **only the department is rolled up**, the status label must be exactly **“SUBTOTAL”** and `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` must be **NULL/blank**;
- when **both** current/non-current and department are rolled up, the status label must be exactly **“TOTAL”** and `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` must be **NULL/blank**.

Order the output **exactly** by: `IS_CURRENT_TERM` **DESC**, then by the **status label** (so within each current/non-current section you get department rows first, then the subtotal, and the total last), then by `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` **ASC**.

Finally, suppress repeating the status label by setting it to NULL/blank whenever it is the same as the immediately previous row’s label (applies to **CURRENT/NON-CURRENT/SUBTOTAL/TOTAL**).
sql4:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    DATEDIFF(
      STR_TO_DATE(ata.TERM_END_DATE, '%d-%b-%y'),
      STR_TO_DATE(ata.TERM_START_DATE, '%d-%b-%y')
    ) AS term_duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
  JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
    ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
    ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    MAX(term_duration_days) AS max_term_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(term_duration_days) AS avg_term_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY IS_CURRENT_TERM, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    CASE
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT'
      ELSE 'NON-CURRENT'
    END AS status_label,
    max_term_duration_days,
    max_units,
    avg_term_duration_days,
    avg_units,
    CASE
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 2
      WHEN OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS label_sort
  FROM agg
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    status_label,
    max_term_duration_days,
    max_units,
    avg_term_duration_days,
    avg_units,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        (IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y') DESC,
        label_sort ASC,
        OFFER_DEPT_NAME ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM labeled
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN rn = 1 THEN status_label
    WHEN status_label = LAG(status_label) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        (IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y') DESC,
        CASE
          WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 2
          WHEN OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END ASC,
        OFFER_DEPT_NAME ASC
    ) THEN NULL
    ELSE status_label
  END AS status_label,
  OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  max_term_duration_days,
  max_units,
  avg_term_duration_days,
  avg_units
FROM ordered
ORDER BY
  (IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y') DESC,
  CASE
    WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 2
    WHEN OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END ASC,
  OFFER_DEPT_NAME ASC;
nlq5:
For courses offered by the Biology and Chemistry departments, group the results by whether the academic term is current and then by department, and summarize term duration and units.

Treat the term start/end dates as text in `DD-Mon-YY` format and compute duration in days as `DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(term_end_date,'%d-%b-%y'), STR_TO_DATE(term_start_date,'%d-%b-%y'))`.

For each group, show:
- a status label: **“CURRENT”** when `IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'`, otherwise **“NON-CURRENT”**
- the department name (`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`)
- max duration (days), max units
- average duration (days), average units

Also include rollup rows:
- when only the department is rolled up (subtotal within a current/non-current section), set the status label to **“SUBTOTAL”** and leave `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` **NULL/blank**
- when both the current/non-current flag and department are rolled up (grand total), set the status label to **“TOTAL”** and leave `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` **NULL/blank**

Sort with current terms first, then non-current; within each section list department rows alphabetically, then the subtotal row; and put the grand total at the very end.

Finally, if the status label would repeat from the immediately previous row, output it as NULL/blank instead (this applies to **CURRENT**, **NON-CURRENT**, **SUBTOTAL**, and **TOTAL**).
sql5:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    DATEDIFF(
      STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(at.TERM_END_DATE, '%d-%b-%y'), '%d-%b-%y'),
      STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(at.TERM_START_DATE, '%d-%b-%y'), '%d-%b-%y')
    ) AS duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
    ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY IS_CURRENT_TERM, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT'
      ELSE 'NON-CURRENT'
    END AS status_label,
    CASE
      WHEN OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME
    END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    max_duration_days,
    max_units,
    avg_duration_days,
    avg_units,
    CASE
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 3
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 1
      ELSE 2
    END AS section_sort,
    CASE
      WHEN OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_subtotal,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_sort
  FROM agg
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    status_label,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    max_duration_days,
    max_units,
    avg_duration_days,
    avg_units,
    section_sort,
    is_subtotal,
    dept_sort,
    LAG(status_label) OVER (
      ORDER BY section_sort, is_subtotal, dept_sort
    ) AS prev_status_label
  FROM labeled
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN status_label = prev_status_label THEN NULL
    ELSE status_label
  END AS status_label,
  OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  max_duration_days,
  max_units,
  avg_duration_days,
  avg_units
FROM ordered
ORDER BY section_sort, is_subtotal, dept_sort;

nlq1:
Can you summarize TIP activity by department and master course code, but only for subjects that have at least one TIP material linked to them?

For each department + master course code, I need:
- the department name
- the master course code
- how many unique subjects are included
- the total of the “new shelf price” for all linked TIP materials
- how many unique TIP materials there are (by ISBN)

Also add a subtotal line for each department and a final grand total line for everything. Please show the department subtotal as “SUBTOTAL” (with no master course code) and the grand total as “TOTAL” (with no master course code). Arrange it so each department’s subtotal comes right after that department’s rows, and the grand total is last.
sql1:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER AS master_course_code,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    tm.ISBN AS material_isbn,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS new_shelf_price
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
dept_master AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS unique_subjects,
    SUM(new_shelf_price) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS unique_tip_materials
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_name, master_course_code
),
dept_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS unique_subjects,
    SUM(new_shelf_price) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS unique_tip_materials
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_name
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS unique_subjects,
    SUM(new_shelf_price) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS unique_tip_materials
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  dept_name AS department_name,
  master_course_code,
  unique_subjects,
  total_new_shelf_price,
  unique_tip_materials
FROM (
  SELECT
    dm.dept_name,
    dm.master_course_code,
    dm.unique_subjects,
    dm.total_new_shelf_price,
    dm.unique_tip_materials,
    0 AS is_grand_total,
    0 AS is_subtotal
  FROM dept_master dm

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ds.dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    ds.unique_subjects,
    ds.total_new_shelf_price,
    ds.unique_tip_materials,
    0 AS is_grand_total,
    1 AS is_subtotal
  FROM dept_subtotal ds

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    gt.dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    gt.unique_subjects,
    gt.total_new_shelf_price,
    gt.unique_tip_materials,
    1 AS is_grand_total,
    1 AS is_subtotal
  FROM grand_total gt
) x
ORDER BY
  is_grand_total,
  dept_name,
  is_subtotal,
  master_course_code;
nlq2:
Can you summarize TIP activity by department and master course code, **using TIP_DETAIL joined to TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED and TIP_MATERIAL** (so only subjects that have at least one linked TIP material are included)?

For each **department + master course code**, return:
- department name
- master course code
- count of **distinct subjects**
- sum of **NEW_SHELF_PRICE** across all linked TIP material records
- count of **distinct TIP materials (distinct ISBNs)**

Also include **rollup totals**:
- one **SUBTOTAL** row per department (department label must be exactly **“SUBTOTAL”** and master course code must be **NULL/blank**)
- one final **TOTAL** row overall (department label **“TOTAL”**, master course code **NULL/blank**)

Important display/order rules:
- **Suppress repeated department labels** by showing the department as **NULL/blank** when it’s the same as the immediately previous row’s department label (but don’t suppress “SUBTOTAL” or “TOTAL”).
- For the **master course code**, show it as **NULL/blank on subtotal/total rows**.
- Order by **department name then master course code**, with each department’s **SUBTOTAL immediately after** its master-course rows, and the **TOTAL row last**.
- Format the numeric outputs as **whole numbers with commas**.
sql2:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER AS master_course_code,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    tm.ISBN AS material_isbn,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS new_shelf_price
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS distinct_subjects,
    SUM(new_shelf_price) AS sum_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS distinct_material_isbns
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_name, master_course_code

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS distinct_subjects,
    SUM(new_shelf_price) AS sum_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS distinct_material_isbns
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS distinct_subjects,
    SUM(new_shelf_price) AS sum_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT material_isbn) AS distinct_material_isbns
  FROM base
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN dept_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN master_course_code IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE dept_name
    END AS dept_display,
    master_course_code,
    distinct_subjects,
    sum_new_shelf_price,
    distinct_material_isbns,
    dept_name AS dept_sort,
    CASE
      WHEN dept_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 2
      WHEN master_course_code IS NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS row_type_sort
  FROM agg
),
suppressed AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN dept_display IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN dept_display
      WHEN dept_display = LAG(dept_display) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, row_type_sort, master_course_code) THEN NULL
      ELSE dept_display
    END AS department_name,
    CASE
      WHEN dept_display IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN NULL
      ELSE master_course_code
    END AS master_course_code,
    distinct_subjects,
    sum_new_shelf_price,
    distinct_material_isbns,
    dept_sort,
    row_type_sort
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  department_name,
  master_course_code,
  FORMAT(distinct_subjects, 0) AS distinct_subject_count,
  FORMAT(sum_new_shelf_price, 0) AS total_new_shelf_price,
  FORMAT(distinct_material_isbns, 0) AS distinct_tip_material_isbn_count
FROM suppressed
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN dept_sort = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  dept_sort,
  row_type_sort,
  master_course_code;
nlq3:
Can you summarize TIP activity by department and master course code, **using TIP_DETAIL joined to TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED and TIP_MATERIAL** (so only subjects that have at least one linked TIP material are included)?

For each **department + master course code**, return:
- department name (OFFER_DEPT_NAME)
- master course code (MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER)
- count of **distinct subjects** (distinct SUBJECT_ID)
- sum of **NEW_SHELF_PRICE** across all linked TIP material records
- count of **distinct TIP materials** (distinct ISBN)

Also include totals **using a single `GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER WITH ROLLUP`** (not separate unions), so that:
- each department gets a **SUBTOTAL** row where the department label is exactly **“SUBTOTAL”** and the master course code is **NULL/blank**
- there is one final **TOTAL** row where the department label is exactly **“TOTAL”** and the master course code is **NULL/blank**

Ordering/display rules:
- Sort so that within each department, master course rows come first and the **SUBTOTAL** row comes immediately after them, and the **TOTAL** row is last overall.
- Suppress repeated department labels by showing the department as **NULL/blank** when it’s the same as the immediately previous row’s department label (but don’t suppress “SUBTOTAL” or “TOTAL”).
- Also suppress repeated **master course codes within the same department** by showing the master course code as **NULL/blank** when it matches the immediately previous row’s master course code for that department.
- Format numeric outputs as whole numbers with commas.
sql3:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS distinct_subjects,
    SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS sum_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS distinct_tip_materials,
    GROUPING(tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS g_dept,
    GROUPING(tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS g_course
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER WITH ROLLUP
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN g_dept = 1 AND g_course = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN g_dept = 0 AND g_course = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME
    END AS dept_label,
    CASE
      WHEN g_course = 1 THEN NULL
      ELSE MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER
    END AS master_course_code,
    distinct_subjects,
    sum_new_shelf_price,
    distinct_tip_materials,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_sort,
    MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER AS course_sort,
    g_dept,
    g_course
  FROM agg
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN g_dept = 1 AND g_course = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
        dept_sort,
        CASE WHEN g_dept = 0 AND g_course = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        course_sort
    ) AS rn
  FROM labeled
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    LAG(dept_label) OVER (ORDER BY rn) AS prev_dept_label,
    LAG(master_course_code) OVER (ORDER BY rn) AS prev_master_course_code
  FROM ordered o
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN dept_label IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN dept_label
    WHEN prev_dept_label = dept_label THEN NULL
    ELSE dept_label
  END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  CASE
    WHEN dept_label IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN NULL
    WHEN prev_dept_label = dept_label AND prev_master_course_code = master_course_code THEN NULL
    ELSE master_course_code
  END AS MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
  FORMAT(distinct_subjects, 0) AS DISTINCT_SUBJECTS,
  FORMAT(sum_new_shelf_price, 0) AS SUM_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  FORMAT(distinct_tip_materials, 0) AS DISTINCT_TIP_MATERIALS
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY rn;

    CASE

      ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
    END AS equiv_cnt
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
),
dept_dim AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    a.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER

  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a

detail AS (
  SELECT
    b.term_code,
    b.department_name,
    dd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
    dd.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.subject_id) AS courses_offered,
    AVG(b.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    0 AS lvl
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN dept_dim dd
    ON dd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = b.department_code
  GROUP BY
    b.term_code, b.department_name, dd.SCHOOL_NAME, dd.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
),
term_subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    b.term_code,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS department_name,
    '' AS school_name,
    '' AS department_phone_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.subject_id) AS courses_offered,
    AVG(b.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    1 AS lvl
  FROM base b
  GROUP BY b.term_code
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS term_code,
    'TOTAL' AS department_name,
    '' AS school_name,
    '' AS department_phone_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.subject_id) AS courses_offered,
    AVG(b.equiv_cnt) AS avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course,
    2 AS lvl
  FROM base b
),
all_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM term_subtotal
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM overall_total
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT
    ar.*,
    CASE
      WHEN ar.lvl = 2 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN LAG(ar.term_code) OVER (
        ORDER BY
          CASE WHEN ar.lvl = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
          ar.term_code,
          ar.lvl,
          ar.department_name

      ELSE ar.term_code
    END AS term_display,
    CASE WHEN ar.lvl = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_total
  FROM all_rows ar
)

  department_name AS department,

  courses_offered,
  avg_equivalent_subjects_per_course
FROM numbered

  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses,

      CASE
        WHEN c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL OR TRIM(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) = '' THEN 0
        ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
      END
    ) AS avg_equiv_subject_count
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN TERM_CODE IS NULL AND DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      ELSE TERM_CODE
    END AS term_label,
    CASE
      WHEN TERM_CODE IS NULL AND DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME
    END AS dept_label,
    num_courses,
    avg_equiv_subject_count,
    TERM_CODE AS term_sort,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_sort,
    (TERM_CODE IS NULL AND DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL) AS is_grand_total,
    (TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL) AS is_subtotal
  FROM rollup_base
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,
    CASE
      WHEN l.dept_label IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN NULL
      ELSE sd.SCHOOL_NAME
    END AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    CASE
      WHEN l.dept_label IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN NULL
      ELSE sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
    END AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
  FROM labeled l
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.dept_label
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
    ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    e.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        e.is_grand_total,
        e.term_sort,
        e.is_subtotal,
        e.dept_label
    ) AS rn
  FROM enriched e
)

  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL OR TRIM(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) = '' THEN 0
        ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
      END
    ) AS avg_equiv_subject_count,
    GROUPING(c.TERM_CODE) AS g_term,
    GROUPING(c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS g_dept
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    rb.TERM_CODE AS orig_term_code,
    rb.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS orig_department_name,
    CASE
      WHEN rb.g_term = 1 AND rb.g_dept = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      ELSE rb.TERM_CODE
    END AS term_label,
    CASE
      WHEN rb.g_term = 1 AND rb.g_dept = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN rb.g_term = 0 AND rb.g_dept = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE rb.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    END AS department_label,
    rb.num_courses,
    rb.avg_equiv_subject_count,
    CASE
      WHEN rb.g_term = 1 AND rb.g_dept = 1 THEN 'zzz'
      ELSE rb.TERM_CODE
    END AS term_sort,
    CASE
      WHEN rb.g_term = 0 AND rb.g_dept = 1 THEN 'zzz'
      WHEN rb.g_term = 1 AND rb.g_dept = 1 THEN 'zzz'
      ELSE rb.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    END AS dept_sort,
    rb.g_term,
    rb.g_dept
  FROM rollup_base rb
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
  FROM labeled l
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.orig_department_name
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
    ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN term_label = 'TOTAL' THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN LAG(term_label) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = term_label THEN NULL
      ELSE term_label
    END AS term,
    department_label AS department_name,
    num_courses,
    avg_equiv_subject_count,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    term_sort,
    dept_sort
  FROM enriched
)
SELECT
  term,
  department_name,
  num_courses,
  avg_equiv_subject_count,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
FROM final_rows
ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

sql1:
WITH session_base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NOT CURRENT' END AS term_status,
    sc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS session_category_name,
    ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS session_key,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN ss.SESSION_START_TIME IS NULL OR ss.SESSION_END_TIME IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(
          0,
          (
            TIME_TO_SEC(
              STR_TO_DATE(
                REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(ss.SESSION_END_TIME)), 'AM', ' AM'), 'PM', ' PM'),
                '%h%i %p'
              )
            ) - TIME_TO_SEC(
              STR_TO_DATE(
                REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(ss.SESSION_START_TIME)), 'AM', ' AM'), 'PM', ' PM'),
                '%h%i %p'
              )
            )
          ) / 86400
        )
      END
    ) AS duration_days
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON d.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY sc
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = sc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    term_status,
    session_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS session_count,
    SUM(duration_days) AS total_duration_days,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days
  FROM session_base
  GROUP BY term_status, session_category_name
),
cat_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    term_status,
    session_category_name,
    SUM(session_count) AS session_count,
    SUM(total_duration_days) AS total_duration_days,
    CASE WHEN SUM(session_count) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(total_duration_days) / SUM(session_count) END AS avg_duration_days
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY term_status, session_category_name
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT
    'ALL' AS term_status,
    'ALL' AS session_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS session_count,
    SUM(duration_days) AS total_duration_days,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days
  FROM session_base
)
SELECT
  term_status,
  session_category_name,
  session_count,
  total_duration_days,
  avg_duration_days
FROM (
  SELECT
    term_status,
    session_category_name,
    session_count,
    total_duration_days,
    avg_duration_days,
    1 AS sort_group,
    term_status AS sort_term,
    session_category_name AS sort_cat
  FROM agg

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    term_status,
    CONCAT(session_category_name, ' (SUBTOTAL)') AS session_category_name,
    session_count,
    total_duration_days,
    avg_duration_days,
    2 AS sort_group,
    term_status AS sort_term,
    session_category_name AS sort_cat
  FROM cat_subtotals

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    term_status,
    session_category_name,
    session_count,
    total_duration_days,
    avg_duration_days,
    3 AS sort_group,
    term_status AS sort_term,
    session_category_name AS sort_cat
  FROM overall_total
) x
ORDER BY
  FIELD(sort_term, 'CURRENT', 'NOT CURRENT', 'ALL'),
  sort_cat,
  sort_group;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    cat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    ses.SESSION_DATE,
    CASE
      WHEN ses.SESSION_START_TIME IS NULL OR ses.SESSION_END_TIME IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(
             HOUR,
             STR_TO_DATE(
               CONCAT(
                 LPAD(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ses.SESSION_START_TIME), '[^0-9]', ''), 4, '0'),
                 ' ',
                 REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ses.SESSION_START_TIME), '[0-9]', '')
               ),
               '%h%i %p'
             ),
             STR_TO_DATE(
               CONCAT(
                 LPAD(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ses.SESSION_END_TIME), '[^0-9]', ''), 4, '0'),
                 ' ',
                 REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(ses.SESSION_END_TIME), '[0-9]', '')
               ),
               '%h%i %p'
             )
           ) / 24.0
    END AS session_days
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL det
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = det.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ses
    ON ses.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = det.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY cat
    ON cat.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = det.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(SESSION_DATE) AS session_date_count,
    SUM(session_days) AS total_session_days,
    AVG(session_days) AS avg_session_days
  FROM base
  GROUP BY IS_CURRENT_TERM, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    session_date_count,
    total_session_days,
    avg_session_days,
    CASE
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT'
      ELSE 'NOT CURRENT'
    END AS status_label
  FROM agg
  WHERE
    (IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL)  -- subtotals by category across statuses
    OR (IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL)  -- overall total
)

    WHEN status_label = LAG(status_label) OVER (ORDER BY (IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL), IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, (IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL), IS_CURRENT_TERM)
      THEN NULL
    ELSE status_label
  END AS current_term_status,
  session_date_count,
  total_session_days,
  avg_session_days
FROM filtered
ORDER BY
  (IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL),  -- TOTAL last
  IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

  SELECT
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(iss.SESSION_DATE) AS session_date_count,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(

          STR_TO_DATE(
            CONCAT(
              LEFT(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, 2), ':', SUBSTRING(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, 3, 2), ' ', RIGHT(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, 2)

            ),
            '%h:%i %p'
          )
        ) / 24.0,
        0
      )
    ) AS total_session_time_days,
    AVG(
      COALESCE(
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
          HOUR,
          STR_TO_DATE(
            CONCAT(
              LEFT(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, 2), ':', SUBSTRING(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, 3, 2), ' ', RIGHT(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, 2)
            ),
            '%h:%i %p'
          ),
          STR_TO_DATE(
            CONCAT(
              LEFT(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, 2), ':', SUBSTRING(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, 3, 2), ' ', RIGHT(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, 2)
            ),
            '%h:%i %p'
          )
        ) / 24.0,
        0
      )
    ) AS avg_session_time_days,
    CASE
      WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT'
      ELSE 'NOT CURRENT'

  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss
    ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc
    ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  GROUP BY at.IS_CURRENT_TERM, isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP

  IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  session_date_count,
  total_session_time_days,

For each row, create a status label:
- If `IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'` → **CURRENT**, else → **NOT CURRENT**
- If `IS_CURRENT_TERM` is NULL and category name is NOT NULL → **SUBTOTAL**
- If both are NULL → **TOTAL**

Return: category name, count of session dates, total session time (days), and average session time (days). Compute session time as the **hour-based** `TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, parsed_start, parsed_end) / 24.0` with missing times treated as 0 (no midnight adjustment), where parsing is done by inserting a colon after the first two digits and adding the AM/PM suffix (e.g., `HHMMAM` → `HH:MM AM`).

Finally, order by the **status label text** and then by category name, and when displaying the status label, show it as NULL if it’s the same as the previous row (based on `LAG(status_label)` over ordering by the label).

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(s.SESSION_DATE) AS session_date_count,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
          HOUR,
          STR_TO_DATE(
            CONCAT(
              INSERT(s.SESSION_START_TIME, 3, 0, ':'),
              ' ',
              RIGHT(s.SESSION_START_TIME, 2)
            ),
            '%h:%i%p'
          ),
          STR_TO_DATE(
            CONCAT(
              INSERT(s.SESSION_END_TIME, 3, 0, ':'),
              ' ',
              RIGHT(s.SESSION_END_TIME, 2)
            ),
            '%h:%i%p'
          )
        ),
        0
      ) / 24.0
    ) AS total_session_days,
    AVG(
      COALESCE(
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
          HOUR,
          STR_TO_DATE(
            CONCAT(
              INSERT(s.SESSION_START_TIME, 3, 0, ':'),
              ' ',
              RIGHT(s.SESSION_START_TIME, 2)
            ),
            '%h:%i%p'
          ),
          STR_TO_DATE(
            CONCAT(
              INSERT(s.SESSION_END_TIME, 3, 0, ':'),
              ' ',
              RIGHT(s.SESSION_END_TIME, 2)
            ),
            '%h:%i%p'
          )
        ),
        0
      ) / 24.0
    ) AS avg_session_days,
    CASE
      WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT'
      ELSE 'NOT CURRENT'
    END AS status_label
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON d.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  GROUP BY at.IS_CURRENT_TERM, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP
  HAVING NOT (at.IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL)
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    session_date_count,
    total_session_days,
    avg_session_days,
    status_label,
    LAG(status_label) OVER (ORDER BY status_label, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS prev_status_label
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  session_date_count,
  total_session_days,
  avg_session_days,
  CASE
    WHEN status_label = prev_status_label THEN NULL
    ELSE status_label
  END AS status_label
FROM final
ORDER BY status_label, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

      ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(
             HOUR,

               CONCAT(
                 INSERT(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, 3, 0, ':'),

                 RIGHT(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, 2)

sql1:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  b.DATE_BUILT AS construction_date,
  b.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type,
  a.address_count,

  AVG(CAST(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS avg_gross_area

JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS room_count
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME,

  b.BUILDING_TYPE,
  a.address_count,

gold_nlq: List the names of the buildings with the most floors. If there are ties, list each one separately.
gold_sql: WITH FloorsPerBuilding AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(ff.LEVEL_ID) - MIN(ff.LEVEL_ID) AS NUM_FLOORS FROM FAC_BUILDING fb JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME ), MaxFloors AS ( SELECT MAX(NUM_FLOORS) AS MAX_FLOORS FROM FloorsPerBuilding ) SELECT a.BUILDING_NAME FROM FloorsPerBuilding a JOIN MaxFloors b ON a.NUM_FLOORS = b.MAX_FLOORS;
biased_nlq: List the names of the buildings where the number of floors is calculated as the maximum floor level minus the minimum floor level for that building, using all floor level values exactly as stored (do not exclude any floors based on whether the floor level looks numeric), and return the building(s) with the largest such value (include all ties).
final_nlq: Which building name(s) have the biggest spread in floor levels—computed for each building as the highest LEVEL_ID minus the lowest LEVEL_ID—using the LEVEL_ID values exactly as stored (no filtering or conversion)? Include any ties.
final_sql:
WITH building_spread AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    MAX(f.LEVEL_ID) - MIN(f.LEVEL_ID) AS level_spread
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
  GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME
),
max_spread AS (
  SELECT MAX(level_spread) AS max_level_spread
  FROM building_spread
)
SELECT bs.building_name
FROM building_spread bs
JOIN max_spread ms
  ON bs.level_spread = ms.max_level_spread;
nlq1: Which building or buildings have the biggest floor range—that is, the difference between the highest and lowest floor level listed for that building (using the floor levels exactly as they’re recorded)? Include any ties.
sql1:
WITH per_building AS (
  SELECT
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    MAX(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) - MIN(CAST(f.LEVEL_ID AS SIGNED)) AS floor_range
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
  GROUP BY b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME
),
max_range AS (
  SELECT MAX(floor_range) AS max_floor_range
  FROM per_building
)
SELECT
  p.BUILDING_NAME,
  p.floor_range
FROM per_building p
JOIN max_range m
  ON p.floor_range = m.max_floor_range;
